movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Interlocked behind the backs of the flanking dancers.
movement_profile.footwork: One step forward on a beat, one step backward on the next.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Two parallel rows facing each other.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Torso bends forward and backward in consonance with the stepping.
movement_profile.partnering: Dancers in a row hold each other by interlocking arms.
movement_profile.posture: Upright with torso bending forward and backward.

signature_moves.description: Synchronized forward and backward stepping with torso movement.
signature_moves.name: Row Sway

music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by the plucked strings of the Rubab and the rhythmic percussion of the Tumbaknadi, supporting romantic songs sung by the dancers.

basic_steps: Stand in two parallel rows facing each other.
Interlock arms behind the backs of the flanking dancers.
Step backward on the next beat.
Bend torso forward and backward in rhythm with the steps.
teaching.formation: Two parallel rows facing each other.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner level due to simple stepping and repetitive movement.
